verdict.rationale: Sprinto's own docs describe a SOC 2 Launchpad that generates a blueprint and lets you action policies, risks, and evidence. They also cite pre-mapped controls, continuous evidence collection, audit-partner selection, and AI validation of evidence before audit submission, so the core SOC 2 program is built in. The evidence never distinguishes Type I from Type II or names the Trust Services Criteria, and all of it is vendor-claimed. Missing for 10: explicit Type I and Type II audit support, a documented Trust Services Criteria control library, specifics on the built-in policy templates, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run a SOC 2 program end to end — Type I and Type II — with the Trust Services controls, required policies, and evidence requests built into the platform

citations.quote: Step‑by‑step, CTA‑driven guide to complete Sprinto’s SOC 2 Launchpad, generate your blueprint, and action policies, risks, and evidence.
Fast-track audits: Automate 80% of manual effort with pre-mapped controls, integrations, and workflows.
Audit readiness by design: Maintain readiness with continuous monitoring, alerts, and evidence collection.
Use Sprinto AI to automatically validate your uploaded evidence for relevance, scope, and timeliness before audit submission.
